entities.summary: Abu Shu'ayb Muhammad ibn Nusayr al-Numayri, commonly known simply as Ibn Nusayr, was an Arab religious leader who is considered the founder of Alawism. He was a contemporary of Ali al-Hadi and Hasan al-Askari, the tenth and eleventh imams in Twelver Shi'ism.
